row: Heeler Farms NY is a vegetable produce farm bringing farm to table freshness to area locals and NY State residents. Formerly Circle G Ranch NY, where we specialized in performance horses; including but not limited to colt starting, reining cow horses, ranch horses, problem horses, tune-ups, minor/major habit adjustments. We still have our own horses, and appreciate their help in making our natural fertilizer. Our 64 diverse acres are privately owned horses and our natural, responsible and sustainable agriculture initiatives. Thank you for your years of support in the community. Stay tuned for our farming videos.
